item.title: Gas prices freeze amid bitter cold in R.I., Mass.
item.description: PROVIDENCE – The average weekly price of self-serve, regular unleaded gasoline in Rhode Island remains at $2.86 per gallon, AAA Northeast said Monday. That price is 4 cents lower than the national average and 14 cents less than it was a year ago. The recent bitter cold temperatures have disrupted petroleum markets, including gasoline demand, which typically declines during […]

item.description: NEWPORT – The cause of a two-alarm fire that tore through the historic Castle Hill Inn on Feb. 5 has been deemed accidental, according to a Monday report by WPRI-TV CBS 12.
